text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely, provided the account is protected with multi-factor authentication."},{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"The company's managed OneDrive and SharePoint are the approved storage locations for company work.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"The company's managed OneDrive and SharePoint are the approved storage locations for company work."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 allows Internal information in personal cloud storage for remote work if protected with multi-factor authentication, while E2 prohibits uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account."}
